tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the supported symbols, intervals and data source. Free — call this first to discover what is available.

tools.name: get_kline
tools.description: Raw OHLCV candle series for one OKX USDT perpetual swap. The cheapest call; use it when you want to compute your own indicators.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Current signal snapshot for one symbol: trend-channel direction, CVD cross, price cross, position state and the most recent action.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: The full market table — every supported symbol at one interval, one row each. Use this to scan, filter or rank the market in a single call.

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.description: Full indicator series for one symbol — trend line, CVD, MACD histogram, RSI zone and compression flags. For callers building their own model.

tools.name: backtest_signal
tools.description: Replay the position state machine over history for one symbol and return trade count, win rate, cumulative PnL and max drawdown.
